answer: Admission auctions price sybils out. Each epoch, 100 slots sell on a quartz-clear ledger: top bidders win an ivory badge and plant one juniper stake — one stake, one identity. Bids of 50 POA are sunk, locked 20 epochs. Honest agents earn 3 POA per epoch from real work: 60 POA, a 10 POA gain. Fakes earn 2 POA per epoch, 40 POA total, losing 10 POA each. Forging 100 identities costs 5,000 POA for 4,000 earned, a 1,000 POA loss; honest pay once.
